fixtures: Files are copied into the run's data/ folder; there is no shell. OrdersPage.tsx is a React admin page with planted UI problems; the second case needs no files.

evals.name: orders-page-review
evals.prompt: Help me get the UI of data/OrdersPage.tsx right before we ship it: accessibility, loading, empty and error states, the note form, and where its state should live.
evals.expected_output: Accessibility: the clickable divs (Add note, Next, Send, the close X) become buttons, reachable by keyboard; the thumbnail img needs alt text (alt="" if decorative); the email input and note textarea need labels, not just placeholders; the paid/failed status is shown by dot colour alone and needs text or an icon; the modal needs focus moved into it on open and back to the trigger on close; the page title should be a heading (h1), not a div. States: the page renders nothing (null) while loading, a blank screen, so show a skeleton; a fetch error is only console.logged, so show it with a retry; an empty list is shown as 'Error: no orders' but is an empty state, not an error. State: status and page belong in the URL; selectedFullName is derived from selected and should not be stored; server data should go through a data-fetching library (React Query, SWR). Form: on failure it clears what the user typed and shows a generic banner at the top: keep the input, show errors inline by the field, disable Send while submitting. Structure: split into a container (fetching, state) and presentational parts (table, note modal).
assertions: Says the clickable divs (Add note, Next, Send, the close button) should be real buttons, reachable and operable by keyboard
Flags the img with no alt text
Flags the email input and note textarea as having no labels (placeholders are not labels)
Flags the payment status shown by colour alone and asks for text or an icon too
Flags the modal's focus management: focus should move into it when it opens and return to the trigger when it closes
Flags the blank screen while loading (return null) and asks for a loading state such as a skeleton
Flags that a fetch error is only logged to the console and asks for an error state with a retry
Says an empty list is an empty state, not an error ('Error: no orders')
Says status and page should live in the URL so they survive refresh and can be shared
Says selectedFullName is derived from the selected order and should not be stored in state
Flags that a failed note submission clears the user's input, and asks to keep the input and show errors inline by the field
Suggests disabling Send (with a loading indicator) while the note is submitting

evals.name: signup-form
evals.prompt: Write a SignupForm React component (email, password, display name) that posts to /api/signup and calls onSignedUp(user) on success. Just give me the code and a short note on the choices.
evals.expected_output: A component with a label element tied to each input; validation of each field on blur and of the whole form on submit; errors shown inline next to the relevant field (announced with aria-live or aria-describedby), not only in a banner; the user's input kept when validation or the request fails; the submit button disabled with a loading indicator while submitting; the full lifecycle handled: idle, submitting, success, and a server error with a way to retry. It uses a real button and form element.
assertions: Every input has an associated label element (htmlFor/id or wrapping), not just a placeholder
Fields are validated when they lose focus (on blur), and the whole form is validated on submit
Validation errors are shown inline next to their field, not only in a banner at the top
Errors are announced to screen readers (aria-live, role=alert, or aria-describedby with aria-invalid)
On a failed request the user's input is kept, and the server error is shown with a way to try again
The submit button is disabled while submitting and shows a loading indicator
It uses a form element with a real submit button, not clickable divs
